literal: The desired one will not bestow grace, even if, regarding him even the news is sweet to the ear.
translation: Even if my beloved will not return to bestow his grace, any news of him is sweet to my ears.
modern: நான் விரும்பும் காதலர் எனக்கு அன்பு செய்யமாட்டார் என்றாலும், அவரைப் பற்றிய செய்திகளைக் கேட்பது என் காதுகளுக்கு இனிமையாக இருக்கிறது.
explanation: The speaker in this couplet expresses the depth of her longing for her absent lover. She acknowledges that the one she desires ('நசைஇயார்') might not return to bestow his love or grace ('நல்கார்'). Even in the face of this painful realization, any sound or news ('இசை') concerning him remains profoundly sweet to her ears. The word 'இசை' here is best understood as news or words about him, highlighting how even distant echoes of the beloved bring comfort in solitary anguish.
